summary: Morph fabric at four PEs: overflows the GW5A-25A LUT budget

correctness.method: Functional correctness comes from sim/unit tb_morph_fabric on the same RTL sources: the scalar recurrence, SIMT SAXPY and systolic GEMM each match their reference exactly. The area and timing numbers in this record are place-and-route results, not a board run.

org.atomix.metric.clock-frequency.method: nextpnr-himbaechel GW5A-25A place-and-route at the 25 MHz board constraint

org.atomix.metric.lut-used.method: Synthesis demanded 23,719 LUT4 against 23,040 available, so no design was realized and there is no used-LUT figure. The demand is recorded under extensions.
